examples.en: My grandmother is 75 years old, but she can use her smartphone without difficulty.
examples.zh: 我祖母 75 歲了，但是她可以毫無困難地使用她的智慧型手機。

examples.en: Many students experience difficulty when learning a new language.
examples.zh: 許多學生在學習新語言時會遇到困難。

examples.en: The team managed to overcome every technical difficulty during the project.
examples.zh: 團隊設法克服了專案中的每一個技術困難。

examples.en: She had great difficulty explaining her complicated ideas to the audience.
examples.zh: 她向觀眾解釋她複雜的想法時遇到了很大的困難。

examples.en: Navigating unforeseen financial difficulties requires meticulous strategic planning.
examples.zh: 應對未預見的財務困難需要嚴謹的策略規劃。

examples.en: You'd better get up now; otherwise, you won't be able to catch the flight.
examples.zh: 你最好現在起床；否則，你將無法趕上飛機。

examples.en: Hurry up, otherwise we will miss the train.
examples.zh: 快一點，否則我們會趕不上火車。

examples.en: He was exhausted, but he forced himself to work otherwise he would fall behind.
examples.zh: 他精疲力竭，但還是逼自己工作，否則他會落後。

examples.en: The weather report predicted rain, but the weather turned out otherwise.
examples.zh: 氣象預報預測會下雨，但結果卻完全不是如此。

examples.en: Environmental regulations prohibit industrial dumping that would otherwise degrade local ecosystems.
examples.zh: 環境法規禁止工業傾倒，否則會惡化當地生態系統。

examples.en: Jenny's boss was standing behind her while she was working, but she wasn't aware of it.
examples.zh: 當 Jenny 在工作時，她的老闆就站在她身后，但她卻全然不知。

examples.en: Are you aware of the new company policies?
examples.zh: 你知道公司的新政策嗎？

examples.en: She became aware of the potential risks before signing the contract.
examples.zh: 她在簽署合約前意識到了潛在的風險。

examples.en: Everyone should be fully aware of the importance of data privacy.
examples.zh: 每個人都應該充分意識到資料隱私的重要性。

examples.en: Maintaining operational security ensures employees remain acutely aware of cyber threats.
examples.zh: 維持營運安全確保員工對網路威脅保持高度警覺。

examples.en: Oliver drank too much and never cared about his health. He eventually got sick.
examples.zh: Oliver 喝太多酒，從來不顧及他的健康，最後終於生病了。

examples.en: If you work hard, you will eventually achieve your goals.
examples.zh: 如果你努力工作，你最終會實現你的目標。

examples.en: After hours of searching, the rescue team eventually found the lost hikers.
examples.zh: 經過數小時的搜尋，救援隊終於找到了迷路的健行者。

examples.en: The complex software bug was eventually fixed by the senior developer.
examples.zh: 這個複雜的軟體錯誤最終由資深開發人員修復了。

examples.en: Persistently pursuing innovative solutions eventually transforms an enterprise's market standing.
examples.zh: 堅持追求創新解決方案最終會轉變企業的市場地位。

examples.en: I called the hotel to confirm our stay for next weekend.
examples.zh: 我打電話給飯店確認我們下週末的住宿。

examples.en: Please confirm your email address by clicking the link.
examples.zh: 請點擊連結確認您的電子郵件地址。

examples.en: The laboratory tests confirmed that the water was safe to drink.
examples.zh: 實驗室測試確認該水質可以安全飲用。

examples.en: The manager will send an official email to confirm the meeting schedule.
examples.zh: 經理將發送官方郵件以確認會議日程。

examples.en: Rigorous empirical data successfully confirms the validity of the scientific hypothesis.
examples.zh: 嚴謹的實證數據成功證實了科學假設的有效性。

examples.en: My little brother is scared of bugs. He is even afraid of ants.
examples.zh: 我的小弟害怕蟲子，他甚至怕螞蟻。

examples.en: Don't be scared; I will protect you.
examples.zh: 不要害怕；我會保護你。

examples.en: The little girl was scared when she heard the loud thunder outside.
examples.zh: 小女孩聽到外面巨大的雷聲時感到很害怕。

examples.en: Many people are scared of speaking in front of a large audience.
examples.zh: 很多人害怕在大眾面前發言。

examples.en: Navigating unprecedented economic shifts often makes market investors deeply scared.
examples.zh: 應對空前的經濟轉變常使市場投資人感到恐慌。

examples.en: Because the final exams are approaching, most of my classmates are studying in the library.
examples.zh: 因為期末考將近，大部分的同學都在圖書館裡讀書。

examples.en: Winter is approaching, so the weather is getting colder.
examples.zh: 冬天快到了，所以天氣變得越來越冷。

examples.en: As we approached the station, we saw the train waiting on the track.
examples.zh: 當我們接近車站時，我們看到火車正停在軌道上等待。

examples.en: The company decided to adopt a new marketing approach to attract younger customers.
examples.zh: 公司決定採用新的行銷方法來吸引年輕客戶。

examples.en: Innovative technological advancements approach a paradigm shift in modern education.
examples.zh: 創新的技術進步正引領現代教育走向典範轉移。

examples.en: It is better to get a pet from an animal shelter; you may save its life.
examples.zh: 從動物收容所領養寵物是比較好的，你或許可以救牠一命。

examples.en: The hikers sought shelter from the heavy rain under a large tree.
examples.zh: 健行者在一棵大樹下尋找避雨的地方。

examples.en: Stray cats and dogs are well cared for at the municipal shelter.
examples.zh: 流浪貓狗在市立收容所受到妥善照顧。

examples.en: Emergency shelters were set up quickly when the hurricane struck.
examples.zh: 當颶風侵襲時，緊急避難所迅速設立。

examples.en: Providing adequate humanitarian shelter is a crucial priority during natural disasters.
examples.zh: 在自然災害期間，提供充足的人道主義庇護所是至關重要的首要任務。

examples.en: The department store becomes very crowded when there is a big sale.
examples.zh: 百貨公司在大拍賣時變得非常擁擠。

examples.en: The subway trains are always crowded during morning rush hours.
examples.zh: 早晨尖峰時段的地鐵總是十分擁擠。

examples.en: We had difficulty finding a seat in the crowded restaurant.
examples.zh: 我們在擁擠的餐廳裡很難找到座位。

examples.en: The popular tourist spot was too crowded for us to enjoy.
examples.zh: 這個熱門景點人太多了，讓我們無法好好享受。

examples.en: Managing pedestrian traffic in densely crowded urban spaces requires sophisticated planning.
examples.zh: 在人口密集的擁擠都市空間中管理行人交通需要精密的規劃。

examples.en: I enjoy my job as a waiter, but I don't think I will work in the restaurant forever.
examples.zh: 我喜歡當服務生的工作，但我認為我不會永遠在餐廳裡工作。

examples.en: True friendship lasts forever.
examples.zh: 真正的友誼天長地久。

examples.en: She promised to cherish these memories forever.
examples.zh: 她答應永遠珍惜這些回憶。

examples.en: Digital data stored in the cloud is not necessarily preserved forever.
examples.zh: 儲存在雲端的數位資料不見得能永久保存。

examples.en: Historical monuments stand as forever reminders of ancient civilizations.
examples.zh: 歷史古蹟作為古代文明的永恆記憶而屹立不搖。

examples.en: The terrified kitten hid under a car when a boy tried to catch her.
examples.zh: 當一個男孩試圖抓她時，這一隻受到驚嚇的小貓躲在車子底下。

examples.en: He was terrified of speaking in public.
examples.zh: 他非常害怕在公眾面前發言。

examples.en: The children were terrified by the loud thunder during the storm.
examples.zh: 孩子們被暴風雨中的巨大雷聲嚇壞了。

examples.en: She felt terrified when she realized she was lost in the dark woods.
examples.zh: 當她發現自己迷失在黑暗樹林中時，她感到驚恐萬分。

examples.en: Market analysts expressed terrified caution amidst unprecedented economic uncertainty.
examples.zh: 市場分析師在空前的經濟不確定性中表達了恐慌的謹慎態度。

examples.en: The monster on TV terrified the little girl.
examples.zh: 電視上的怪獸嚇到小女孩。

examples.en: Heights tend to terrify some people.
examples.zh: 高度往往會嚇到有些人。

examples.en: The sudden loud noise terrified the stray dog.
examples.zh: 突如其來的巨大聲響嚇壞了流浪狗。

examples.en: Horror movies are designed to terrify audiences.
examples.zh: 恐怖電影旨在嚇唬觀眾。

examples.en: Cybersecurity threats continually terrify corporate risk management departments.
examples.zh: 網路安全威脅不斷嚇壞企業風險管理部門。

examples.en: The kids played around for hours in the yard, and they all felt exhausted.
examples.zh: 孩子們在庭院玩了好幾個小時，他們全部精疲力竭。

examples.en: I feel exhausted after working a twelve-hour shift.
examples.zh: 上了十二小時的班後，我覺得精疲力竭。

examples.en: The marathon runners looked completely exhausted at the finish line.
examples.zh: 馬拉松選手在終點線看起來精疲力竭。

examples.en: She was too exhausted to cook dinner, so they ordered takeout.
examples.zh: 她累得沒辦法煮晚餐，所以他們點了外賣。

examples.en: Sustained overwork leaves employees physically and mentally exhausted.
examples.zh: 持續過勞會讓員工身心俱疲。

examples.en: The long walk exhausted the old man, so he lay down and took a nap.
examples.zh: 走了很久的路讓這個老人精疲力竭，所以他躺下來小睡一下。

examples.en: Intense studying before the exam completely exhausted him.
examples.zh: 考試前的密集K書讓他精疲力竭。

examples.en: The grueling training schedule exhausted the team members.
examples.zh: 艱苦的訓練日程讓團隊成員體力耗盡。

examples.en: Industrial production can rapidly exhaust local natural resources.
examples.zh: 工業生產會迅速耗盡當地自然資源。

examples.en: Unregulated resource extraction will eventually exhaust global energy supplies.
examples.zh: 不受規範的資源開採終將耗盡全球能源供應。

examples.en: When Dad needs to work late, he usually drinks a cup of black coffee to stay awake.
examples.zh: 當爸爸需要工作到比較晚時，他常常喝杯黑咖啡來保持清醒。

examples.en: She lay wide awake in bed, unable to fall asleep.
examples.zh: 她躺在床上毫無睡意，完全清醒著。

examples.en: The baby remained awake throughout the entire flight.
examples.zh: 這名嬰兒在整個航程中都是醒著的。

examples.en: Drinking coffee too late at night can keep you awake for hours.
examples.zh: 太晚喝咖啡會讓你清醒好幾個小時。

examples.en: Maintaining vigilant situational awareness keeps operators mentally awake during night shifts.
examples.zh: 保持警覺的情境意識能讓作業員在夜班期間保持精神清醒。

examples.en: Lily wanted to have a dog, so her mom took her to a shelter to adopt one.
examples.zh: 因為 Lily 想要養狗，所以她的媽媽帶她去收容所領養一隻。

examples.en: Many families choose to adopt homeless pets.
examples.zh: 許多家庭選擇領養無家可歸的寵物。

examples.en: The city council decided to adopt the new environmental policy.
examples.zh: 市議會決定採納這項新的環境政策。

examples.en: She hopes to adopt a more active lifestyle this year.
examples.zh: 她希望今年能採取更積極的生活方式。

examples.en: Corporations increasingly adopt sustainable business practices to meet global standards.
examples.zh: 企業日益採用永續的商業實踐來符合全球標準。

examples.en: It was a blessing that Ruby didn't really get hurt when she fell off the second-floor balcony.
examples.zh: Ruby 從二樓陽台摔下來卻沒怎麼受傷，真是件幸運的事。

examples.en: Good health is the greatest blessing in life.
examples.zh: 健康的身體是人生最大的福氣。

examples.en: Her parents gave their blessing to the young couple's marriage.
examples.zh: 她的父母給這對年輕夫妻的婚姻給予了祝福。

examples.en: Sometimes losing a job turns out to be a blessing in disguise.
examples.zh: 有時候失業反而因禍得福。

examples.en: Experiencing such profound challenges proved to be a mixed blessing for his career growth.
examples.zh: 經歷如此深遠的挑戰對他的職涯成長來說可謂禍福參半。
